name: 60126 · Elmhurst, IL
findings: ZIP 60126 (Elmhurst) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 119 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 104 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60126 (Elmhurst) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60126 (Elmhurst) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
